description.value: Pacifico Pizzeria & Ristorante is a downtown Vancouver Italian restaurant that combines Pacific Northwest ingredients with traditional Italian recipes and has earned recognition as Vancouver's Best Pizzeria. The Smithe Street location offers dine-in and online takeout or delivery, with a second outpost near English Bay on Davie Street. It sits in the heart of the city core, making it a practical meal stop for cyclists on urban routes.
